reviews.text: Our Sadie looked and smelled amazing after her grooming session! We will be booking again for sure!

I brought my Great Pyrenees to Megz for a full groom, and anyone with a Pyr knows that's no small job. She was patient with her, took her time working through all that undercoat, and sent me updates throughout the groom so I always knew how she was doing. My girl came home clean, fluffy, and looking great, with noticeably less fur ending up all over my house. You can tell Megz genuinely cares about the dogs she works with. Highly recommend her,
Great place for real quality , caring for my fur kids. This is the.place to come to.
Great and friendly customer service. She was fast yet thorough. Me and my dog were very satisfied.

She did a fantastic job grooming my three Yorkies! Handling one small dog can be a task, but doing three at once and making them all look this good is true talent. They came out looking neat, clean, and happy. I will definitely be back!
Customer for life! Great price. Great groom. Great communication. AND she caught my dog’s ear infection. Thank you so much for your professionalism, patience, and kindness! We’ll see you again soon!

Thank you for the review! Thanks for
Trusting me with your baby!  See you next
Time 😊  …
Megan greeted me with a caring smile & was so loving to my cat! I just moved back to Phoenix & as long as we live here, my cat will get her "mani-pedi"/nail trim at Megs! ❤️

This was the first time i took my newly adopted cat for a nail trim and was not sure how he would react. She was very patient with him and it went well.
I will be returning.

My dog is old and getting her last grooming. Im so thankful I found Megan. She is the most supportive, kindest and understanding of my dogs and my needs. Im having the hardest time and knowing that her last groom is being done with so much love and care has made it easier

Meigan did an amazing job with my Golden Retriever/Chow mix! She was incredibly thorough yet efficient with his bath, trim, and de-shedding, and he was ready in less than two hours. He came home happy and looking unbelievably handsome!

Her services are an excellent value, and I especially love that she provides one-on-one care without kenneling. Meigan was attentive, detail-oriented, and made me feel completely comfortable leaving him in her care. I also really appreciated the thoughtful recap she sent after his appointment. We had a wonderful experience and will definitely be returning!

First time having my dogs groomed by Meg! I have 2 former fear dogs and an XL Bully! Meg worked her magic and was so patient with them and did an amazing job with them.
My dogs have never looked so clean and smelled so good.
I would give her 1M stars ⭐️ if I could.
Highly recommend her!
Thank you Meg for your patience and professionalism with my crew.
Love, Harleigh, Cooper, and Finn. 🐕🐾❤️
2nd time I’ve brought my min poodle in to Megz. She’s affordable does a great job and I love the fact she has only one dog at a time. So less stressful. Thank you

Meagan was wonderful with Rupert, my recent rescue dog. She bathe him and trimmed him, but then he got nervous about having his nails trimmed.She only took him as far as he was comfortable to go, but I am sure that when I take him back the next time he will be even more receptive to her. She has the knack to put dogs at ease.

My dog has been banned from FOUR groomers and Meg was the only one who was patient and able to handle her. She has never looked so beautiful 😍🩷 thank you so much for taking care of my Grizzly bear 🩷 …
Meg did a wonderful job grooming my golden doodle. I just moved to Phoenix recently and was struggling to find a good groomer that was affordable. Meg fits all the criteria and I will be a regular!

Just moved here and feel so lucky to have found Meigan at Megz Pet Grooming🩷🩷🩷she s absolutely amazing, caring and very compassionate. My Morkie, Piper, really needed her grooming and I am so very happy👍🩷 We found our new Groomer and could not be happier! ✨✨✨✨✨

We had a wonderful experience with Meg! she was very kind, accommodating and very gentle with our kitties. One of out cats can get very feisty when scared but she found ways around that and had both out cats squeaky clean and smelling fresh. We will definitely come back 😊 …
